post.caption:
Faraday's induction says electricity and magnetism are one relationship read two ways. Which means a motor and a generator are literally the same machine: feed it current and the shaft turns, turn the shaft and current comes out. Coal, gas and nuclear all do the identical final step, boiling water to push a turbine that spins a magnet. Hydro and wind push the same wheel without the boiling. Solar is the odd one out, with no spinning anything.
